Stage 3 now consumes reviewed input meanings and separate evaluator predictions. It discovers the required public signatures, emits Java, compiles once against the older API, and freezes its class archive. The application planner resumes that archive, preserves fix-only predictions and can rescore qualified raw observations. Numeric measurements are independently compared with JDI returns and exceptions.

The primary original Spring run saw both parent exceptions and both fixed 127 returns in the declared runtime types on two repetitions. All 53 selected test suites passed. Job 20261126-214343-qualify-generated-numeric-and-lazy-publi repeats the six frozen questions and their cache controls.

commits.summary: Generate stateful callers and live helper tables (verification pending)
commits.body:
The product now emits an original-classpath caller for retained graph and map views, ordered commands and listener events, marked byte streams, archive rewrites with independent JDK reopen, and class-token writers and readers. It can discover actual minimum arguments and returns at the public consumer, derive the independent table, and reject uncovered applications or a mismatched helper class. Generated numeric and alias projections have live debugger controls. A self-only legacy JAR index is qualified only at its real deployment name.

All eight development callers compiled in the restricted operator workspace, including Kryo on JDK 8. All 53 selected suites passed. The first pipeline run stopped before measurement because its build lived outside the checkout. The planner now honors the runner-supplied checker. Jobs 20261126-215855-repeat-spring-and-vavr-observers-with-th, 20261126-215632-replay-generated-archives-streams-and-in, 20261126-215633-qualify-generated-retained-graph-map-and, 20261126-215633-generate-the-live-commons-io-minimum-tab and 20261126-220022-challenge-generated-callers-with-false-g cover the independent JVM checks and mechanism falsifiers.
